title: Mazungumzo ya Kimuktadha (Theme 9: Afya bora)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names the setting and the listener, then chooses words that fit: friendly with friends, respectful with elders, even informally.

floor.prerequisite: Uses greetings for the time of day.
floor.question: Asubuhi unamsalimuje rafiki?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child acts a short chat with a friend and then with an elder.

listen_for: hotuba ya mwalimu mkuu kwenye gwaride
misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni mazungumzo yapi si rasmi?" Kwa nini "hotuba ya mwalimu mkuu kwenye gwaride" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mazungumzo yasiyo rasmi ni ya marafiki, nyumbani au wakati wa kucheza. Hotuba na mahojiano ni rasmi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Unamsalimia rafiki yako uwanjani. Utasema ___." Kwa nini "Mabibi na mabwana, hamjambo?" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kwa rafiki tunatumia lugha ya kawaida, kama "Mambo vipi?". Hotuba hutumia lugha rasmi.
Hata nyumbani, mzee husalimiwa kwa heshima: Shikamoo babu.
Hata mazungumzo yasiyo rasmi yana adabu: subiri zamu yako.

checks.question: Ni muktadha upi si rasmi: mkutano wa wazazi, mchezo na marafiki?
